d: Great temple dedicated to the sun with ara and simulacrum of the same. Cosroe, Siroe and Medarse.
Emira in man's dress with the name of Idaspe and sayings.
Inside room of Cosroe with coffee table and chair. Siroe with sheet.
Cosroe, Siroe aside and then Laodice.
Emira under the name of Idaspe and sayings.
Siroe, then Emira under the name of Idaspe.
Cosroe and Emira, and then Medarse.
Land apartments corresponding to 'garden with chairs. Siroe, and then Cosroe and Emira under the name of 'Idaspe.
Arasse, and Emira prisoner without Guards.
Closed and enclosed in the castle destined for prison in Siroe. Siroe, then Emira.

The great square of Seleucia. In the opening of the scene there is a mix between the rebels and the royal Guards, who are entrenched and flee. Cosroe, Emira and Siroe one after the other, with bare sword, at Arasse with the whole People; Cosroe defending himself from some Conjured, falls.
